title: Master Magic Mod
description: Decode magical scrolls and unlock powerful spells and much more
body:
**Master Magic Mod** is a magic-focused Minecraft mod that adds a system of spells, scrolls and magical research.
Instead of simply crafting spells, players must discover and decode them using magical tools. Unknown scrolls can be deciphered at the Decoding Table through a small puzzle, turning magic into a process of discovery rather than instant crafting.
The mod introduces new magical items, wands and equipment that allow players to cast spells and experiment with arcane powers.

<details>
<summary>Features</summary>
  
- Spell system with scrolls and a spell book
- Decoding Table with mini-game
- Several magical wands
- Magical armor and equipment
- Mana-based spell casting
- Custom magic items and materials

</details>
